title: Inventory: Dimitrov et al. 2009 (Genetics 183:365) source files
intro: The only source file is the PubMed Central full-text page (PMC2746160), fetched 2026-11-02 with a plain request from
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2746160/ and kept untouched as `raw/PMC2746160.html` (an identical copy is
`sources/dimitrov2009/article.html`). It carries the full text and Tables 1-4. The PDF link on PMC
(pdf/GEN1831365.pdf) answered with a proof-of-work bot check instead of the file; it was not worked around.
Facts used by the atlas are quoted verbatim in `extracted/text_facts.tsv` (kind, section, quote).

roles.PMC2746160.html: PMC full text (HTML): abstract, methods, results, figure legends, Tables 1-4 (strains; petite mutation rates; strain genotypes at SAL1, CAT5, MIP1, MKT1; mitochondrial introns). Source of every number the atlas uses.

missing: Supporting information (File S1, Figures S1-S3, Table S1 primers) is hosted at genetics.org / academic.oup.com, which refuses requests from the build environment (403); not fetched.
The article PDF (PMC serves a proof-of-work bot check instead of the file).
No table of QTL: loci, windows and direction come from the Results text and the Figure 3 and Figure 5 legends. LOD-type statistics are only plotted (Figure 3A).
No per-segregant phenotypes or genotypes (the 2957 markers are from Brem and Kruglyak 2005).
